plan: My value for the prize is $10. Bidding above $10 is dominated as it risks a loss if I win. Bidding less than $10 risks losing the auction without a chance to profit. To maximize profit, I should bid close to $10 but slightly lower to account for others possibly bidding close to their values. I will bid $9.9, aiming to win only if the third-highest bid is significantly lower, ensuring a profit.

Given my private value of $6, bidding above this would result in a loss if I win, as I'd pay more than the prize is worth to me. To maximize profit, I should bid below or at my value. Bidding exactly $6 is risky if others bid higher. Therefore, I'll choose a lower bid to avoid overpaying if I win.

My private value for the prize is $4. Bidding above my private value is dominated since it risks a loss if I win. Therefore, I should bid at most $4. Bidding $0 is also dominated as it guarantees losing with no profit. I will bid slightly below $4 to maximize the chance of winning while minimizing the payment, assuming others may bid closer to their values.
